'''Slotern''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] where a [[Battle of Slotern|battle]] was fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and a [[Unidentified resistance group|resistance group]]<ref name="TIE">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] "[[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]]" databank entry}}</ref> sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Date">The [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' comic]] dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]; therefore, the events described in the in-game databank, including the [[Battle of Slotern]], must have happened by 1 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was founded in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', and since the battle was fought against the Empire, it must have taken place between these two dates.</ref> The world was located in the [[Slotern system/Legends|Slotern system]] of the [[Wazta sector/Legends|Wazta sector]], which was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Slotern was mentioned in the "TIE fighter" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released in [[2010]].<ref name="TIE" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Slotern [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Slotern, in grid square J-18.<ref name="EAOC" />
